rationale: C19 plausibly supplied a material letter template: both recognize a candidate's or appointee's established public record, express confidence in handling major responsibilities, wish the recipient “every success,” and close with warm regards. This combination of parallel content, sequence, and language is stronger than the isolated campaign-success phrase in C20 or the ceremonial formulas in C09.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your awareness of national responsibilities ... and your courage in performing the duties of public office are well known to your friends.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your distinguished career is well known on this side of the Atlantic, and has earned our widespread respect.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish the recipient's fitness by invoking a publicly recognized record of service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I want to wish you every success in your campaign and extend my warmest regards to yourself and your family.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For myself, and for the people of the United States, let me wish you every success in carrying out the great responsibilities which now devolve upon you as Prime Minister. With warm regard.
shared_material.explanation: The closing closely parallels the distinctive sequence “wish you every success” followed immediately by warm regards.
